title: fix(app-shell): ask the adapter which params degraded, so a targetless master_detail gets the #3405 hints
body:
Fixes #5654

`ActionParamDialog` decided who gets the #3405 "paste a record id" hints with its own literal over **raw** param spellings, while the degradation it was reacting to is performed by `paramToField` over **resolved widget keys**. Neither set contained the other, so the dialog was wrong in both directions.

`paramToField` now exports one predicate, `paramDegradesWithoutTarget(param)`, and both its own fallback branch and the dialog's two hint readers ask it. One membership table (`LOOKUP_WIDGET_TYPES`) remains on this surface, read from one place. `master_detail` was **not** hand-added to the dialog line — that third copy is the defect this card exists to end.

## Deliberate behaviour change

A `master_detail` action param with no `referenceTo` now receives `actionDialog.lookupPlaceholder` and `actionDialog.lookupHelpText`. It already degraded to a plain text input and already warned in dev; it just arrived at the user as an unexplained empty box wanting a bare UUID. Declared in `.changeset/action-param-degrade-predicate-5654.md`.

## Measured before/after — the card's table, driven through the real dialog

Rows 1-2 are the change. Rows 3-6 are **controls**: a probe that cannot fail is not evidence, so each of these must stay put while row 1 moves.

| param | degrades? | hints before | hints after | role |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `master_detail`, no target | yes | **none** | **placeholder + help text** | the fix |
| `master_detail`, `referenceTo: 'accounts'` | no | none | none | control — the picker must still mount (`lookup-trigger-parent`) |
| `lookup`, no target | yes | both | both | control — unchanged |
| `reference`, no target | yes | both | both | control — the alias row; reading resolved keys must not cost it its hints |
| `lookup`, `referenceTo: 'sys_user'` | no | none | none | control — pre-existing #3094 pin |
| `no-such-type` | no (renders text for another reason) | none | none | control — a reader keyed on the RENDERED type alone would decorate this one |

The last row is why the dialog now asks the predicate instead of `field.type === 'text'`: the old conjunct was a proxy for "did this degrade?", and the predicate answers that exactly. The equivalence (`predicate(param)` ⇔ `paramToField(param)` replaced the param's own widget with the text fallback) is swept over every `FORM_FIELD_TYPES` member plus every alias in `paramToField.test.ts`, with the degrading rows named — `['lookup', 'master_detail', 'reference']` — so the sweep cannot pass vacuously.

## Scope

`paramToField.ts`, `ActionParamDialog.tsx`, their two test files, one changeset. No doc touch: `paramToField` is internal to `@object-ui/app-shell` (not re-exported from its `index.ts`), so the new export changes no documented surface.

Filed rather than repaired in this PR: **#5880** — the same degrade set is stated once per package (`app-shell` and `plugin-grid`'s `bulkParamToField`) with nothing tying the two. Members are identical today, so no live defect; the two predicates key on different fields, so merging them is a decision rather than a mechanical convergence.

Note for whoever lands **#5875** (prose-only, same two files): this PR adds prose to `paramToField.ts` and `paramToField.test.ts` but does not touch the "fourth and last private copy" sentences that card is about — expect a textual merge, not a contradiction.
